title: Gloom #44 Topps Pokemon TV Animation Edition 1999 Trading Card Series 1
descriptionText:
#44 Gloom
1999 Topps Pokémon, TV Animation Edition Series 1
Base card — the standard non-foil printing
Black Topps logo printing
Type: Grass. The second evolutionary stage of Oddish
First appearance: Episode 26, "Pokémon Scent-sation"
Officially licensed by Nintendo; a Topps trading card, not a Pokémon TCG game card
Condition: Excellent. Light edge wear consistent with a card of this age. No creases, no bends, no writing, and the printed surface is clean. Photographed front and back under natural light — what you see is the exact card you receive.
